sloka: भ्रातरं सुरथं राज्ये ह्यभिषिच्य महीपतिम् ।इदं सरः समासाद्य तपस्तप्तं मया चिरम् ।। ७.७८.९ ॥
transliteration: bhrātaraṁ surathaṁ rājye hyabhiṣicya mahīpatim ।idaṁ saraḥ samāsādya tapastaptaṁ mayā ciram ।। 7.78.9 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, having consecrated my brother Suratha as king in the kingdom, I reached this lake and performed penance for a long time.
